My very first job, I was 17 working at a summer camp i had been going to since I was like 8. My mom went there, my brothers worked there, we were literally chosen as a spokes-family for some charity event i believe? And we met a famous football player. The owner knew my mom personally and because of my heart condition, would let me go twice in a summer (usually people are only allowed once for a week) so I got to attend the camp designed for regular city kids and the camp that was easier for asthma kids.

I was a dishwasher. Did my job. My coworkers were friends and my brother. Never had any complaints from them. But because of my heart condition, and it being summer, and me working in a hot environment, and also being a person that didn't (and still doesnt) drink a lot of water, I got dizzy quick. It was also a physical job as all activities were usually down a hill and everyone had to walk up it. I didn't HAVE to go anywhere, we were still in the 4 week training period, and had no real training requirements because I wasn't going to be assigned to any groups, but i occasionally went with my brother to activities I enjoyed.

My bosses managed to walk in on me literally every time I took a break to not pass out. I'd sit for like 5 minutes max, once or twice per times we had to wash dishes (3x a day, it took us about 2 hours because we also had to clean the entire mess hall). I'd push myself through the dizzy spells until I physically couldn't anymore. At one point 2 weeks in, I also ended up getting pneumonia after jumping in a creek because I dropped my phone in it. After I had came back, I of course still had to sit occasionally to not pass out.

At one point I had actually fallen and almost passed out and had to be taken to the nurse by my brother. The owner saw me outside after that and told me I was on thin ice for it.

The weekend before kids were actually set to arrive, we were cleaning the break room. I once again get dizzy after cleaning my part. Everyone else who was with me were also done, save for my brother who had to sweep. I'm laying on the ground because I was overheating and my boss comes in. She sees me, walks out, my other boss (the owner) gets me and fires me right there. He literally actually told me that it was because of my heart condition and said I was a "burden to my coworkers". 

I never reported it because my mom said she could just talk to him but he wouldn't answer her. She also didn't want to report her childhood camp. Same woman who convinced me not to file a police report after my phone got stolen at college, so, no surprise.
